title: Date range picker
summary: A start and an end date with quick ranges (last 7 days, this month), a minimum and maximum, and an inline error when the end is before the start. Built on native date fields, so keyboard, touch and the platform picker come with it.

props.name: name
props.description: The form field name. The submitted value is the ISO interval start/end, for example 2026-09-01/2026-09-07, or empty when neither date is set.

props.name: start
props.description: The first day, an ISO date such as 2026-09-01. A form reset sets it back to its initial value without raising the commit event, as a native control does: pk-form raises pk-reset after it. A browser state restore also sets it silently.

props.name: end
props.description: The last day, an ISO date (inclusive). Same reset and restore behaviour as start.

props.name: min
props.description: Earliest allowed ISO date. A date before it makes the field invalid and disables a quick range that lies wholly before it.

props.name: presets
props.description: The quick ranges to offer, comma separated, in order: today, 7d, 30d, 90d, month, lastmonth, year. Empty for none. A range is cut to min and max.

props.name: calendar
props.description: Adds a calendar button after the end field that opens a pk-calendar in range mode in a pk-popover. The first click sets the start, the second the end and closes it; the fields stay, so the calendar is an addition and the native inputs are the fallback. Focus moves into the calendar on open, and Escape closes it and returns focus to the button.

props.name: label
props.description: The accessible name of the group (aria-label). pk-field fills it from its own label when this is empty.

props.name: startLabel
props.description: The accessible name of the start field; "Start date" when empty. Set it to localise.

props.name: endLabel
props.description: The accessible name of the end field; "End date" when empty.

props.name: description
props.description: Help and error text, exposed as aria-description; pk-field fills it.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Blocks interaction; also set by a disabled fieldset.

props.name: readonly
props.description: Shows the range without letting the user change it.

props.name: required
props.description: The form cannot be submitted until both dates are set.

props.name: invalid
props.description: Shows the invalid state and sets aria-invalid; set by pk-field or pk-form (or by a Blazor EditContext). The element also shows its own error when the end is before the start or a date is outside min and max.

events.name: input
events.description: A field changed while the user typed (native, composed: bubbles out of the shadow root). Read event.target.start and event.target.end.

events.name: change
events.description: The user committed a date or a quick range (re-dispatched from the inner control, composed).

events.name: pk-range-change
events.detail: { start: string, end: string, valid: boolean }
events.description: The range changed by the user (a date typed or picked, a quick range, clear). valid is false when the end is before the start or a date is outside min and max; the values are still reported so the host can show its own message.

parts.name: fields
parts.description: The row of the two date fields.

parts.name: error
parts.description: The inline error text (role=alert), hidden when the range is fine.

parts.name: popover
parts.description: The calendar popover (a pk-popover), present with the calendar attribute.

parts.name: opener
parts.description: The calendar button that opens the popover.

parts.name: calendar
parts.description: The range pk-calendar inside the popover.

methods.name: clear()
methods.description: Empties both dates and raises pk-range-change.

a11y: A role=group named by label with two native date inputs named Start date and End date (segments move with the arrow keys, the platform picker opens from the field). Quick ranges are buttons in a named group with aria-pressed on the one that matches the current range and disabled when they fall outside min and max. An invalid range sets aria-invalid on both fields and shows a role=alert message tied to them with aria-describedby. With the calendar attribute the button carries the popover disclosure (aria-expanded, aria-haspopup=dialog), focus moves to the calendar day on open and returns to the button on Escape or after the range is chosen. On a phone every control is at least 44px tall.

examples.title: Limited to a window, no quick ranges
examples.html: <pk-date-range-picker label="Trip dates" min="2026-09-01" max="2026-09-30" presets="" start="2026-09-10" end="2026-09-18"></pk-date-range-picker>
